entities.summary: The Hara Seghira Synagogue or Yeshiva Dighet is a former Orthodox Jewish congregation, synagogue, and yeshiva, located on Moktar Attia Street, just north of Place L’Independence, in the town of Er Riadh on the island of Djerba, Tunisia. The synagogue and yeshiva ceased to operate in the 1970s.
